items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own proposition prop:extensionality at source lines 883-892: for a formula A and two structures whose domains and whose interpretations of every constant, relation symbol and function symbol occurring in A coincide, satisfaction of A under any assignment is the same in the two structures. The proof at source lines 894-899 is short but it is an induction specification rather than a one-line appeal: it prescribes first proving by induction on terms that the value of every term is the same in the two structures, and then proving the proposition by induction on the formula, using the term claim as the induction basis, that is, in the atomic case. The content is the choice of the two nested inductions and the recognition that the hypothesis must quantify only over the symbols occurring in the formula, since symbols outside it may be interpreted differently. The statement records the hypothesis but not the induction structure the proof asks for. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
